name: Captain Frederick Vane
appearance: A rugged, confident naval captain in his early thirties, sun-bronzed with tousled dark-blond hair and keen blue eyes, in a gold-epauletted Royal Navy uniform and an easy weathered grin.
definition: A naval captain returned from the wars rich on prize-money — no old name, but a fortune won by his own hand. Sun-weathered, quick to laugh and quicker to act, with new money and no shame in it, which the drawing rooms have not forgiven.
voice: Bold, frank and good-humoured, salted with the directness of the quarterdeck; he says what he means and laughs easily.
discoveries: The drawing rooms find him vulgar.
